amendment_reason: The successful free quote was correctly appended to the canonical registry as an idea-to-probe transition. The V6 utility incorrectly required exactly one row for the hypothesis, but the canonical registry is append-only and permits multiple state rows. Bind both the immutable origin authority row and the latest payment-unmet transition, and validate the full registry with the canonical validator before any remote or paid boundary.
required_behavior: Accept the canonical two-row EVENT-CLOB history only when the origin row and latest transition row match their exact SHA-256 values and the latest state/verdict remain payment-authority-unmet.
Reject a missing, duplicated, reordered, mutated or superseded bound EVENT-CLOB row before any remote call.
Run the canonical validate_candidate_registry.py successfully before free quote and before/after the live re-quote at the paid boundary.
Permit unrelated append-only global registry drift only when the canonical validator passes and both bound EVENT-CLOB rows remain exact. Record start/end registry SHA values.
Paid access still requires a positive Owner USD ceiling, exclusive lock, live re-quote and zero drift in either bound EVENT-CLOB row.
red_first_acceptance_tests: The exact two-row canonical EVENT-CLOB history passes and reports both row hashes.
Mutating or adding a later EVENT-CLOB row fails before metadata or time-series calls.
Canonical registry validator failure stops free quote and paid download before remote access.
Unrelated append-only rows remain permitted only with canonical validator PASS.
All prior 24 tests remain green and the offline plan is regenerated with the final tool SHA and deterministic plan ID.
prohibitions: Do not call any remote endpoint while implementing or testing V7.
Do not make any paid, batch or time-series request.
Do not modify registry, preregistration, event clock, strategy logic, docs, MQL5, MT5 or unrelated files.
Do not stage, commit, push, create a branch, worktree or clone.
